text: The vault is bare except for three chests and four full-height mirrors covered in black sheets. The mirrors share one room and are the only return mechanism from the Brugh.

views.text: Three chests glitter beneath a moonlit gallery. Four tall mirrors promise bright hallways, though the second reflection seems to watch on its own.
Three chests stand in an unfurnished stone vault. Four covered mirrors line the north wall; the second sheet stirs without a draft.
